notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.

This is GOG hardware V3 (LiVE): default channels Pedal 7, Manual I 9, Manual II 10, stops/accessories 16 (not 12). CC7 general volume (40-127) is sent but its channel is not stated, so no master volume is mapped.
AGO console (32-note pedal, three swell shoes; only Manual II's CC11 is mapped). Stops can be exchanged per sample set, so names on your console may differ.
The website lists "SUB. I / OCT. I" under Manual II as well as Manual I; those under Manual II are entered here as Manual II octave couplers (Sub II / Oct II). Check on your organ.
Mixture/Cornet/Scharff ranks are not published (entered without ranks; Cornet entered at 8').
